ayahOccurrences.text: فَسَتَذْكُرُونَ مَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ ۚ وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: فَسَتَذْكُرُونَ مَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ ۚ وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: وَأُفَوِّضُ is in the derivative form: أفَوِّض
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ف/و/ض   f–w–ḍ to submit to, to authorise; confusion, to be disorderly, anarchy; negotiation, exchange of ideas, consultation; also said to include: making clear the discourse. Of this root, أفوِّض ʾufawwiḍ, occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
أفَوِّض ʾufawwiḍ [imperf. of v. II. trans., with prep. إلى] to submit something to, to entrust something to, to commit to

(40:44)‏ فَسَتَذْكُرُونَ‏ ‏مَا‏ ‏أَقُولُ‏ ‏لَكُمْ وَأُفَوِّضُ‏ ‏أَمْرِي‏ ‏إِلَى‏ ‏اللَّهِ ‏ [one day] you will remember what I am saying to you [now], so I commit my case to God.
